title.narrative: Support for Global Water Security and Sanitation Partnership multi donor trust fund 2019-22

description.narrative: GWSP aims to support client governments to achieve water related SDGs and develop climate resilient water management through the generation of innovative global knowledge and the provision of country-level support.

The Danish support the Global Water Security and Sanitation Partnership multi donor trust fund 2019-2022 involves a strategic focus on improving water security, climate resilience, gender and social inclusion as well as supporting GWSP's engagements in fragile and conflict-affected countries. Moreover, Denmark has key competences and cutting-edge technology in the water sector and could access commercial knowledge in areas such as energy efficient pumping, hydrological modelling or low-tech sanitation.
The Danish contribution to GWSP is monitored on the basis of GWSP's own annual performance reporting. The latest report can be found at the following link: https://www.worldbank.org/en/topic/water/publication/annual-report-2021-global-water-security-and-sanitation-partnership
